subject: FinTrust access controls handoff — SSO/SCIM, IP allowlist & service account ownership
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <security@fintrust.com>, Alice Wu <alice.wu@fintrust.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: FinTrust access controls handoff — SSO/SCIM, IP allowlist & service account ownership

Hi Samir / Alice,

Thanks for the kickoff earlier today. Per our call, I wanted to capture the immediate handoff items so your team and ours are aligned for implementation next week. High-level agenda below and two asks at the top: please confirm the primary technical contact for SCIM provisioning, and share the current IP CIDR blocks used by your outbound proxies (we'll need them for the allowlist).

Top asks (please reply inline):
- Primary SCIM technical contact (name + email) — we need the API owner for attribute mapping and testing.
- IP ranges for FinTrust egress / test envs (CIDR list) — we'll add to our allowlist and share a dry-run plan.

Planned work items for the first sprint:
1) SSO/SAML: Exchange SP metadata, rotate cert timeline (we support RSA 2048 and ECDSA), and verify ACS/RelayState behavior.
2) SCIM: Attribute mapping review (uid/email/scim.entitlements), placeholder user sync, and conflict-handling defaults.
3) IP allowlist: Add FinTrust CIDRs to staging and canary routes, then run tokenized requests during the dry-run.
4) Service accounts: Agree ownership and lifecycles; we will provide a service-account ownership matrix for signoff.
5) Org policies: Minimum password / session settings and audit log retention (suggest 90 days for realtime logs, 1 year for retention archive).

Attachments: fintrust-sso-scim-checklist.xlsx (initial checklist), ip-allowlist-cidrs.txt (placeholder — please replace), service-account-ownership-matrix.csv (draft).

Proposed next steps:
- Samir: confirm SCIM contact & CIDRs by EOD Thu 7/2.
- Redwood (Monica/Ben): prepare SCIM attribute mapping doc and a staging dry-run window (we suggest 7/8 10:00–12:00 PT).
- Joint dry-run: validate SSO + SCIM + IP allowlist in staging, then cutover to prod during a guarded window.

If this looks good I'll open a HubSpot MQA with the proposed dates and share a Drive folder where we'll centralize evidence and runbooks.

Thanks — looking forward to a smooth handoff.

—
Vanessa Ortiz
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

From: Samir Shah <security@fintrust.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Alice Wu <alice.wu@fintrust.com>
Cc: itops@fintrust.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 10:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FinTrust access controls handoff — SSO/SCIM, IP allowlist & service account ownership

Thanks Vanessa — quick answers inline and a couple of questions.

Inline:
- SCIM contact: Alice Wu (alice.wu@fintrust.com), she owns provisioning.
- CIDRs: see attached ip-egress-cidrs.txt (we've attached to this reply and copied to your Drive link). Note we have two clusters (prod and staging) and a separate tunneling egress for partners; we'll need both staged.

Questions / clarifications:
1) Attribute mapping: We use employeeId as the authoritative uid (not email). Does Redwood support employeeId as the SCIM userName and map email separately? We want to avoid duplicate accounts when people change email aliases.
2) Service accounts: We have a central IT service account owner (itops@fintrust.com) but also app-level owners. For the dry-run, can Redwood accept delegated owner emails in the CSV? Our risk team requires a TTL on any long-lived keys and auditability for actions performed by service accounts.
3) Certification rotation: Our security policy requires cert rotation every 12 months; confirm Redwood's recommended rotation process and if you support automated cert rollover for SAML SP metadata.

Also tagging: Alice please confirm which attributes need to be writable by SCIM and which should be read-only (we expect department/title to be writable).

Best,
Samir

Subject: Re: FinTrust access controls handoff — SSO/SCIM, IP allowlist & service account ownership

Looping in engineering and security architecture with the details Samir provided. Short notes and next internal actions from our side:

1) SCIM: We support employeeId as the SCIM userName (we map by externalId/employeeId). Monica will draft the attribute mapping doc and push to the Drive folder today. We'll set default conflict resolution to prefer externalId for dedupe. Action: Monica -> attribute-mapping doc by 6/30 EOD.

2) SAML cert rotation: Ben, can you confirm support for automated rollover and whether we need a scheduled maintenance window? Our recommended approach is to publish new SP metadata 48 hours before swap and a 72-hour overlap.

3) Service accounts: I've attached the ownership matrix draft (service-account-ownership-matrix.csv). Please add owners for any app-level SA and include TTL guidance — we will default to 90-day keys unless the app owner requests a different TTL with justification. Action: All -> fill ownership column by 7/2.

4) IP allowlist: We will add FinTrust CIDRs to staging instantly; for prod we will gate via canary route. Ben will own the canary where we route 5% of traffic for 2 hours to validate.

Quick internal Qs:
- Ben: confirm canary config and whether the canary supports varying TLS client cert checks.
- Neha: I'll need the audit-log retention config for the live tenant (we suggested 90 days / 1 year archive).

One-line replies encouraged if you're OOO. I'll update the Drive folder and link back in the external thread after owners are confirmed.

—
Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <security@fintrust.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 16:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FinTrust access controls handoff — SSO/SCIM, IP allowlist & service account ownership

Samir / Vanessa — good progress. Quick confirmations from infra:

- Canary: we can route 5% of auth traffic to FinTrust staging within the gateway and perform a 2-hour validation window. TLS client cert checks are supported but will require an additional header validation step for mutual TLS; for the dry-run we'll rely on standard TLS + IP allowlist.
- Cert rotation: Redwood supports automated rollover. We'll publish new SP metadata 48 hours prior and maintain old metadata for 72 hours overlap. We'll plan for a maintenance window only if you want to force a single-swap cutover.
- SCIM: confirmed we accept employeeId as externalId/userName and will not auto-merge unless externalId matches.

Proposed dry-run schedule: 2026-07-08 10:00–12:00 PT (staging) — Redwood infra will run the canary and Monica will perform provisioning checks. After successful validation we'll schedule a minimal-risk prod cutover week of 7/13–7/15.

I've dropped the signoff checklist in the shared Drive and created the HubSpot task: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/FT-2026-0421 (HubSpot task #FT-0421-ONB). Please review the checklist and add owners to the CSV by 7/2 so Monica can schedule the dry-run.

Thanks — see you in the runbook.

—
Ben Carter
Engineering — Inference Infrastructure | Redwood Inference
